name: blessedtxts-com
description: Free Bible verse generator and online Bible reader

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/parse-bibles.mjs && node scripts/build-search-index.mjs && node scripts/copy-chapter-json.mjs && node scripts/generate-assets.mjs && node scripts/ensure-indexnow-key.mjs
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && cross-env SKIP_PDF=1 node scripts/generate-downloads.mjs && astro build
scripts.build:fast: cross-env SKIP_PDF=1 PUBLIC_ENABLE_PDF=0 npm run prebuild && cross-env SKIP_PDF=1 PUBLIC_ENABLE_PDF=0 node scripts/generate-downloads.mjs && cross-env PUBLIC_ENABLE_PDF=0 astro build && node scripts/indexnow-submit.mjs
scripts.build:full: npm run prebuild && node scripts/generate-downloads.mjs && cross-env PUBLIC_ENABLE_PDF=1 astro build && node scripts/indexnow-submit.mjs
